240-5470-6495-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.

Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-7730.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

549-3698-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-3698-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat from step 5.
549-3698-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

4452-6871-6879-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-6871-6879-8095.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat from step 3.

512-950-4188.easyPrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.

Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Accomplished Alchemist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-4188.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Accomplished Alchemist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2957-4881-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
2957-4881-6909-8198.easyPrerequisites: Imagecrafter does not have summoning sickness.
2957-4881-6909-8198.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Carnage to become an Elf until end of turn
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

141-3085-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-4050.description:

Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat.

855-1806-2060-3967-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.

You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.

Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.

2051-3518-5751--38.manaNeeded: {G} or enough mana to activate the land's cycling cost additionally
2051-3518-5751--38.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in your graveyard.

2051-3518-5751--38.description:
Activate the cycling land's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Holding priority, activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {G}{G}{G} if you have no {G} available or adding three mana of the color used to cycle the land otherwise.
Resolve the cycling ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning the cycling land and up to two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand except the cycling land.
Repeat.

1692-3617-3662.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
1692-3617-3662.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Izzet Chemister.
1692-3617-3662.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1462-1545-2232-2413-2768.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 8.
You have not cast a spell using Demon of Fate's Design's ability this turn.
Creatures you control excluding Trostani have total base toughness 7 or greater.
1462-1545-2232-2413-2768.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying 7 life due to Demon of Fate's Design.
When Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
When the Dragon(s) enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve all but one Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the final Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Day of the Dragons to your hand from the battlefield.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled with Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
 When the creatures that were exiled by Day of the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times, and Trostani triggers for each creature except itself.
Resolve all Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the collective toughness of the other creatures that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If creatures you control excluding Trostani have total base toughness 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite life.
